# A first look at functions

A function maps each input to exactly one output.

## Mathematical notation

$$f(x) = 2x + 1$$

Scientific notation also works: \(\rho = \frac{m}{V}\), where density is mass divided by volume.

blocks.title: Science tip
blocks.content: Density is mass divided by volume: $$\\rho = \\frac{m}{V}$$.

blocks.question: Which expression represents density?
blocks.explanation: Density is mass per unit volume.

blocks.title: Reveal a hint
blocks.content: Think about how many units of mass fit into each unit of volume.
